fullPassage: A successful presentation relies on employing various presentation skills, such as using friendly gestures, making natural eye contact, and speaking with an appropriate volume. But just as important, well-designed slides play a critical role in effectively conveying your message. Here are some useful tips for improving your presentation slides. First, adopt a "less is more" approach by keeping your slides simple. Limit each slide to five lines of text and use phrases instead of full sentences. This allows the audience to focus more on listening than on reading. Next, prioritize readability by carefully selecting attractive font sizes and colors. The best readability is generally achieved with a font size of at least 18 pt, and you should limit slides to three or four colors to avoid distraction. Lastly, enhance your slides with high-quality images that complement the text. By following these simple tips, you can create effective slides that hold your audience's interest and keep them engaged from start to finish!

questions.passage: Here are some useful tips for improving your presentation slides. First, adopt a "less is more" approach by keeping your slides simple. Limit each slide to five lines of text and use phrases instead of full sentences. This allows the audience to focus more on listening than on reading. Next, prioritize readability by carefully selecting attractive font sizes and colors. The best readability is generally achieved with a font size of at least 18 pt, and you should limit slides to three or four colors to avoid __________. Lastly, enhance your slides with high-quality images that complement the text. By following these simple tips, you can create effective slides that hold your audience's interest and keep them engaged from start to finish!
questions.stem: 다음 **영어** 단어를 찾아 (영어로) 쓰시오. 슬라이드 색상을 3~4가지로 제한하는 이유는 __________을 피하기 위해서이다. (1단어)

det.korean: 산만함(distraction)을 피하기 위해 색상을 제한한다.
det.analysis: distraction(산만함): 원문 'limit slides to three or four colors to avoid distraction'에서 직접 확인.
det.tip: distraction = 주의 분산/산만함. avoid distraction = 산만함을 피하다. distract(동사) → distraction(명사)

questions.passage: But just as important, well-designed slides play a critical role in effectively conveying your message. Here are some useful tips for __________ (improve) your presentation slides. First, adopt a "less is more" approach by keeping your slides simple.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 프레젠테이션 슬라이드를 개선하기(improving) 위한 유용한 팁들.
det.analysis: improve(동사) → improving(동명사): 전치사 for 뒤에 동명사가 필요.
det.tip: 전치사(for, in, on, by) + 동명사(-ing). tips for improving = 개선하기 위한 팁

questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 빈칸에 들어갈 문장을 완성하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)

[on / the / more / focus / listening / reading / audience / on / to / than]. (10단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 청중이 읽기보다 듣기에 더 집중할 수 있게 한다.
det.analysis: This allows the audience to focus more on listening than on reading: allow + O(the audience) + to V(focus) + 비교구문(more on A than on B)
det.tip: allow + O + to V = ~가 ~하도록 허용하다. focus more on A than on B = B보다 A에 더 집중하다

questions.ans: the audience to focus more on listening than on reading

questions.passage: A successful presentation relies on employing various presentation skills, such as using friendly gestures, making natural eye contact, and speaking with an appropriate volume. But just as important, well-designed slides ____ effectively conveying your message. Here are some useful tips for improving your presentation slides. First, adopt a "less is more" approach by keeping your slides simple. Limit each slide to five lines of text and use phrases instead of full sentences. This allows the audience to focus more on listening than on reading. Next, prioritize readability by carefully selecting attractive font sizes and colors. The best readability is generally achieved with a font size of at least 18 pt, and you should limit slides to three or four colors to avoid distraction. Lastly, enhance your slides with high-quality images that complement the text. By following these simple tips, you can create effective slides that hold your audience's interest and keep them engaged from start to finish!

Well-designed slides __________ effectively conveying your message.

조건: play, role, critical을 반드시 포함할 것. (5단어) (영어로)

det.korean: play a critical role in = 중대한 역할을 한다
det.analysis: play a critical role in ~ing = ~하는 데 중대한 역할을 하다. 주어 slides가 복수이므로 play가 정답. plays도 허용.
det.tip: play a role in = ~에 역할을 하다. critical/important/key role = 중대한/중요한/핵심적인 역할

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞게 영작하시오.

"주의가 산만해지지 않도록 슬라이드를 3~4가지 색상으로 제한해야 한다."

You should __________.

조건: limit, avoid, distraction을 반드시 포함할 것. (10단어) (영어로)

det.korean: limit slides to three or four colors to avoid distraction = 산만함을 피하기 위해 색상을 제한하다
det.analysis: limit A to B = A를 B로 제한하다. to avoid distraction = 산만함을 피하기 위해(to부정사 목적).
det.tip: limit A to B = A를 B로 제한. to avoid = ~을 피하기 위해(목적의 to부정사). distraction = 산만함

questions.ans: limit slides to three or four colors to avoid distraction
